given: a stock row whose inventory_code is a hyphen-delimited location-batch-serial code such as "A12-B7-S001"
then: batch_number is set to the second hyphen-delimited segment ("B7") and serial_number to the third ("S001"), taken from the code by delimiter and not by fixed width

independence.rationale: AC1 only asserts the columns exist and are addressable; a build could add empty columns yet never populate them. This AC is the separately-breakable backfill-parse outcome on a conforming code.

architectural_notes: Infra: a contract on the persisted data-store state after migration, verified by querying the stock table on the paired Lakebase branch (never mocked). Realized by the backfill step of the Alembic migration (infrastructure), which parses inventory_code by hyphen delimiter — segment 2 -> batch_number, segment 3 -> serial_number — not by fixed width. The parse rule is deterministic data-transform logic owned by the migration; app/repositories still owns ORM access and the boundary/service are not involved. Cross-cutting concern: correct data derivation under R1 (no corruption).
